sources.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create a production-source atlas of 16 top-down JRPG stone BUILDING CONSTRUCTION tiles matching the attached approved FFII environment style: warm cream limestone masonry, ochre trim, muted green grass, crisp GBA-quality pixel clusters, dark colored outlines, upper-left light. This is an exact 4-column by 4-row opaque full-bleed square atlas (1024x1024 ideal), sliced into 64px tiles later. NO grid lines, gutters, separators, frames, letters or labels. Do not include reference labels or props.
First three columns and first three rows together form a connected rectangular roofless building: grass outside, a low thick cream masonry wall around its perimeter, tan flagstone floor inside. Straight wall segments must connect across adjoining cell boundaries at the SAME offset and thickness, about one quarter tile from outer edge. Floor has sparse readable stone detail. No isometric diamonds or tall perspective walls.
EXACT ROWS:
1: outer-NW wall corner; north wall segment; outer-NE wall corner; full grass outside fill.
2: west wall segment; full interior flagstone center; east wall segment; alternate full interior flagstone fill.
3: outer-SW wall corner; south wall segment; outer-SE wall corner; lightly worn full interior flagstone fill.
4: concave INNER corner with grass bite at tile NW and flagstone in remaining area; same grass bite at NE; grass bite SW; grass bite SE.
Each concave corner has cream masonry boundary bending 90degrees around the grass bite. Outer corners have the grass side outside the building; inner corners invert that relationship. Keep edge connection thickness consistent with straight pieces. No doors, windows, torches, objects, shadows outside tile boundary, black dividing lines, isolated floating blocks, gradient painting. Full bleed pixel texture edge to edge. This is a practical modular wall/floor kit, not a scene illustration.
sources.revisionPrompt: Edit this exact 4x4 stone building tile atlas. Reconstruct the local grass/floor/wall pixel texture where these lines were. Preserve natural mortar seams in the masonry and joints in flagstones. Keep all16 tile identities, positions, wall shape/thickness, outer and inner corners, colors and pixel art style exactly. No gutters or grid. Opaque full-bleed squareimage. No new objects, labels or borders.

sources.prompt:
Create a production-source blue SLATE ROOF building-corner tile atlas matching the attached approved FFII pixel-art environment. Crisp GBA-quality clustered pixels, dark colored outlines, warm ochre timber fascia, blue slate shingles and muted green grass. Exact4x4 opaque full-bleed square atlas, ideally1024x1024; each of16cells exports to64px. NO drawn grid lines, separator lines, gutters, frames, labels or text. Top-down orthographic JRPG roof plane; no isometric diamonds, no front facade, no walls, no chimney/props.
The first3columns of first3rows must assemble into ONE blue-shingled rectangular roof on grass, with straight timber fascia around the outside. The shingles are horizontal overlapping bands and run fully to cell edges where they join. Keep roof shading shallow and uniform so extending center and edge tiles works. No strong lighting gradient across the assembled roof. Fascia remains at fixed same offset/thickness (~one quarter tile) for all straight and corner connections.
EXACT ROWS:
1: outer-NW roof corner; north roof edge; outer-NE roof corner; full grass outside-fill.
2: west roof edge; full blue slate center-fill; east roof edge; alternate blue slate center-fill.
3: outer-SW roof corner; south roof edge; outer-SE roof corner; slightly worn blue slate center-fill.
4: INNER concave roof corner with grass bite at tile NW and blue roof remaining; same grass bite NE; grass bite SW; grass bite SE. Timber fascia follows each90degree bite and connects the straight edge profiles.
No copied study labels, no soft painterly shading, no diagonal decorative seams across fills, no artificial cell borders. Preserve individual16cell identities and standard cardinal orientation. This is a practical modular building roof tilekit.
sources.revisionPrompt: Repair this exact4x4 roof tile atlas. Remove the unnatural thin GREEN GRASS GRID GUTTERS at all three vertical and horizontal cell boundaries (25%,50%,75%). Preserve grass where it truly belongs OUTSIDE the roof and in the four concave corner bites. Preserve the 16individualtile identities, exactcellpositions, standard3x3rectangularroof and bottomrow4innercorners. Do not shift, rescale or add borders. notes: All new tiles are candidate artwork; logical edge compatibility does not establish pixel-perfect seamlessness.
Revisions remove artificial separator lines and grass gutters. Actual exported tile proofs are not painted over.
